sources.q: Where does the content come from?
sources.a: Prayer times use AlAdhan. Quran text and audio come from Quran.com. Hadith collections use sunnah.com and open authentic datasets. Duas and many tools use local curated data plus UmmahAPI. Every major page shows attribution.

offline.a: Yes for core practice. The PWA caches prayer times, Quran, and hadith responses so you can keep reading when connectivity drops.

methods.q: Can I change the prayer calculation method?
methods.a: Yes. Settings lets you pick calculation method, madhab, high latitude rule, and fine tune offsets so times match your local convention.

privacy.a: Coordinates you approve are stored locally in your browser. When you use prayer times, Qibla, mosque finder, or location labels, those coordinates are sent to prayer and map APIs (such as AlAdhan, Nominatim, and Overpass) to fetch times and nearby places. We do not sell data and the app is ad free.

ads.a: No ads. The product is designed as a calm, distraction free space for daily practice.

shahada.title: Al Shahada
shahada.subtitle: The declaration of faith
shahada.intro: The Shahada is the foundational testimony of Islam. Muslims declare that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and that Muhammad is His messenger.
shahada.fullTransliteration: Ash hadu an la ilaha illa Allah, wa ash hadu anna Muhammadan rasul Allah.
shahada.fullTranslation: I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.
shahada.part1Transliteration: Ash hadu an la ilaha illa Allah.
shahada.part1Translation: I bear witness that there is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.
shahada.part2Transliteration: Wa ash hadu anna Muhammadan rasul Allah.
shahada.part2Translation: And I bear witness that Muhammad is the messenger of Allah.
shahada.meaningBody: The Shahada affirms monotheism (tawhid) and acceptance of Muhammad as the final prophet. It is the gateway to Islam and is recited in prayer, conversion, and daily remembrance.

inheritance.title: Inheritance Calculator
inheritance.subtitle: Sunni faraid for common heirs
inheritance.howItWorks: Choose the sex of the deceased first. If the deceased is male, enter the number of wives (0–4). If female, mark whether the husband is alive (only one). Then add sons, daughters, and whether the father or mother is alive. The calculator applies Quranic fixed shares (spouse, parents, daughters alone), gives residue to sons as asaba (2:1 with daughters), uses umariyyatayn when only parents and a spouse remain, and applies awl or radd when shares do not add up to the full estate.
inheritance.disclaimer: Educational tool only. Does not cover siblings, grandparents, full hajb (blocking) rules, debts, wasiyyah, or unassigned residue beyond the spouse-only case shown here. Consult a qualified scholar for real cases.

notes.empty: Add heirs to calculate shares. This tool covers spouse, parents, sons, and daughters only.
notes.base: Educational estimate (Sunni faraid). Does not cover siblings, grandparents, debts, or wasiyyah. Consult a qualified scholar for real estates.
notes.awl: Awl applied: fixed shares exceeded the estate and were reduced proportionally.
notes.radd: Radd applied: leftover returned to blood heirs with fixed shares (not the spouse).

sources.methodologyBody: islam.house compiles public Islamic data APIs with clear attribution. We do not invent hadith grades or Quran text. Prayer times use published calculation methods you can change in Settings. Report issues from any content page. Brand: islam.house (not affiliated with islamhouse.com).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: What stays on your device and what we fetch from trusted APIs
privacy.intro: Islam Sanctuary is built to work with minimal personal data. We do not sell data or run ads on religious content. This policy explains what is stored in your browser and what is requested from third party services when you use the app.

local.title: Data we store locally
local.question: What data do you store on my device?
items: Prayer calculation preferences (method, madhab, tune offsets)
Theme, language, Quran display settings, and notification toggles

cookies.title: Cookies and similar storage
cookies.question: Do you use cookies?

Optional Cloudflare Web Analytics only after you accept, with no advertising cookies

thirdParty.title: Data sent to third parties
thirdParty.question: Do you send any data to third parties?
thirdParty.bodyBefore: When you use location or search features, coordinates or queries may be sent to third party services, including AlAdhan (prayer times and Hijri dates), Nominatim and Overpass/OpenStreetMap (reverse geocoding and nearby mosques), OpenFoodFacts (product lookups), UmmahAPI, XAUS, Aloula, and MP3Quran (radio streams). Quran text, translations, and audio come from the fawazahmed0 Quran API and CDN. Hadith and duas may load from public CDNs listed on our
